intro.heading: Discover Ancient Egypt
leadParagraphs: A Uniworld Egypt & Nile River Cruise offers one of the world's most extraordinary travel experiences. Journey along the legendary Nile River while exploring iconic landmarks including the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, Luxor Temple, Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Kom Ombo, and Aswan.

Combined with luxury accommodations, expert Egyptologists, exclusive excursions, and Uniworld's award-winning boutique service, this itinerary provides an unforgettable way to experience one of the world's oldest civilizations.
intro.quote: Journey along the legendary Nile River while exploring iconic landmarks including the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, Luxor Temple, Karnak Temple, and the Valley of the Kings.

faqs.question: Is a Uniworld Egypt & Nile River Cruise worth the money?
faqs.answer: Yes. It combines luxury hotels, boutique river cruising, guided sightseeing, domestic flights, gourmet dining, and exceptional service into one unforgettable vacation.

faqs.question: What is included on a Nile River Cruise?
faqs.answer: Luxury accommodations, guided excursions, many meals, airport transfers, domestic flights, Wi-Fi, gratuities, and expert Egyptologist guides are generally included.

faqs.question: Does the itinerary include the Pyramids of Giza?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most itineraries include a guided visit to the Great Pyramids and the Great Sphinx in Cairo.

faqs.question: Is Abu Simbel included?
faqs.answer: Abu Simbel is often available as an optional excursion depending on the itinerary.

faqs.question: Are Egyptologists included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional Egyptologists accompany guests throughout the journey.

faqs.question: Are drinks included?
faqs.answer: Many beverages are included during meals and onboard, depending on the sailing.

faqs.question: Does Uniworld include gratuities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Onboard gratuities are included on most Uniworld cruises.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available onboard, though speeds may vary in remote areas.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Egypt?
faqs.answer: October through April offers the most comfortable weather for sightseeing.

faqs.question: Who should choose this itinerary?
faqs.answer: History lovers, luxury travelers, photographers, bucket-list travelers, and first-time visitors to Egypt.

faqs.question: Is this itinerary suitable for first-time visitors?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. It combines Egypt's most iconic attractions into one expertly planned luxury vacation.
